how: the planted controls are the seat's own runs. Main's code confirms the facts behind six of them: the wrong hypercharge weight and extra doublets break the one-loop relation (B1956's coefficients); a commutator term changes the two-loop mixing (checks/sm_rge_matrix.py: the mixed products matter at that order); 3w for 6w fails at order 15 and the Szego case changes the exponents (checks/agyexp_ur345.py); right-multiplying changes the flow's covariance. The figures themselves were not rerun
